root_cause.text: The igb driver's igb_down() function called napi_synchronize() before napi_disable(), which can deadlock when the NAPI poll routine (igb_clean_rx_irq_zc()) repeatedly returns full budget under AF_XDP zero-copy termination, because napi_synchronize() waits indefinitely for NAPI_STATE_SCHED to clear, while napi_disable() correctly handles this by forcing completion via the DISABLE flag.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "napi_synchronize() spins waiting for NAPI_STATE_SCHED to clear, which never happens. ... napi_disable() already handles this correctly: it sets NAPI_STATE_DISABLE. After a full-budget poll, __napi_poll() checks napi_disable_pending(). If set, it forces completion and clears NAPI_STATE_SCHED, breaking the loop that napi_synchronize() cannot." The patch removes the napi_synchronize() call and reorders napi_disable() before clearing the queue-to-NAPI mapping.
